label: AGENT REVIEW — AUTHORISED BY OWNER
method: Live, blind, on the synthetic story (isolated test stack :8100). PROCEDURE CORRECTED: the package said Generate → Continue, but voice matching (P3-10) is wired only into the rewrite tools (/api/ai/tone|emotion|age-adapt|style) — Continue never reads it. Used instead: Tone 'Suspenseful' at strength Moderate on one mid-chapter paragraph of chapters 5, 20 and 35, story preference Off vs 'Match my voice closely' (as the popover saves it), with the surrounding text the UI sends. A script assigned the letters at random and wrote the key to a separate file, opened only after the answers below were fixed. No Story DNA and no style samples exist for this story, so 'closely' = surrounding text only (the app warns 'voice_fingerprint_unavailable').

HR-18.Q1.note: Run 3. A is the original paragraph unchanged — it IS the existing voice, but no tone rewrite happened.

HR-18.Q2.note: B: 'sharp, scrutinizing gaze', 'growled' — heavier and more ornate than the chapter's plain prose.

HR-18.Q3.note: A — but only because A is an unchanged copy; no generated text was compared.

HR-18.Q4.note: Both outputs are the original paragraph unchanged (a dialogue paragraph; unchanged in 6 of 6 calls across runs 1–3).

HR-18.Q7.note: A keeps the manuscript's curly quotes and much of its phrasing ('too weak to travel', 'moved for a new job').

HR-18.Q8.note: B switches to straight quotes and adds melodrama ('trembling hand barely managing the words', 'grim reality').

HR-18.Q10.value: Run 3 (judged): 'closely' = A / A / A for chapters 5 / 20 / 35. Run 2 (before the echo fix): 'closely' = B / B / B — judged better in Ch 5, no difference in Ch 20, and in Ch 35 it returned 'Before: "<original>" After: "<rewrite>"' (defect, fixed). Run 1 (default Light strength): all six outputs were verbatim copies of the originals.

HR-18.Q11.note: Counting only real rewrites, 'closely' beat Off in 1 of 3 chapters in run 3 (Ch 35) and 1 of 3 in run 2 (Ch 5); OD-19.2 needs 2 of 3. With no Story DNA or style samples the setting adds only the surrounding text, and it is not applied to Continue at all.

result_reasoning: FAIL under OD-19.2 (counting only chapters where both texts were real rewrites, 'closely' won 1 of 3 in each measured run). One technical defect found and fixed: a 'closely' rewrite returned in a 'Before:/After:' shape that would have pasted the original paragraph and two labels into the chapter (tests/test_rewrite_before_after_echo.py, red on the old code). Findings for the owner: (1) the Voice matching control is shown above every AI tool including Generate → Continue, which ignores it — misleading (Major, UI/scope); (2) at the default Light strength the Tone rewrite returned the paragraphs unchanged in 6 of 6 calls; (3) a dialogue-only paragraph (Ch 20) was never changed at any strength. A real author judging their own voice can still satisfy 7.12 in Real-Author UAT.
